attrs.evidence: R5's gate inferred the obligation from the status: any claim at PROVED was allowed to satisfy ANY of {universal_affirmation, universal_refutation, existence}, and the consumption relation accepted the kind if it could discharge any one of them. GPT-5.6's audit reported that a universal PROVED claim therefore passes on a single constructive witness, or on a counterexample. REPRODUCED HERE against the shipped `consume()` before accepting: both returned ACCEPTED for a synthetic universal. That is precisely the laundering the Mosaic exists to refuse, committed by the mechanism built to refuse it. The fix is the separation — `status` is an epistemic lifecycle state, `obligation` is the logical shape the support must establish — and all 75 settled claims (at INV-R7.5) now carry one, assigned by reading each statement rather than defaulted. `status_obligation_domain` still constrains which obligations are coherent with a status (a REFUTED claim may not claim universal_affirmation; a KNOWN claim is dischargeable only by cited_result), but it no longer supplies the obligation.
attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6, round-5 Mosaic audit §3, which found the hole and specified the fix.

readjudicated.method: redeclared_by_target — a declared design invariant is adopted deliberately, not inherited
readjudicated.note: The source-lane status is recorded in imported_from.source_status as provenance. This field records that the TARGET lane re-established it; the two are separate facts and the gate reads this one.

attrs.statement: Every settled claim declares the exact logical obligation its support must discharge, as a field separate from its status; status never substitutes for the proposition's shape.
attrs.supersedes: the status-inferred obligation rule shipped in R5
